title: Size-Constrained Agglomerative Clustering
hook: Two tightly linked blocks want to merge, but the container is too small. What now?
cardText: No cluster may exceed capacity C. Impossible, stuck on a wrong path, and legal-but-not-optimal are three different endings.
description: Greedy merging with a hard capacity: telling apart “provably impossible”, “greedy walked into a dead end” and “legal but not optimal”, and reporting legality separately from reaching K.
